text:
ana-cs: Heads-up: Maprise annual renewal is in play. Procurement wants to change to quarterly Net30 invoices (they said "cashflow preference") and asked for a delegated-signer clause so their procurement team can sign invoices only. They also want a short early-termination credit for seat reductions mid-term. Need legal + finance input before we send.

leo-acct: Can you paste current ARR and seat counts? Also what discount/term are we offering if they move off annual prepaid?

ana-cs: set of numbers: Current ARR $96,000 (800 seats), currently annual prepaid. Proposal from CS: convert to 12mo term with quarterly billing Net30, keep seats flat, convert to 5% committed discount in exchange for the billing change. Customer verbally agrees to discount but procurement insists on delegated-signer & PO reference on invoices.

tiffany-legal: Delegated-signer clause ok in principle. We need precise scope: limit to invoice acceptance and PO acknowledgement only, not contract amendments. Draft language: one short paragraph naming "Authorized Procurement Delegate" and specifying authority. Also check whether early-termination credit triggers affect revenue recognition; finance should weigh in.

ravi-finance: Quarterly Net30 is workable but we need: 1) updated billing entity (legal name + tax id), 2) credit-app for >$75k exposure, and 3) AR process for split invoices (achieve correct accounting codes). Early-term credit will change revenue deferral; need exact formula (pro rata / fixed schedule). If they keep seats flat it's easier.

sam-ops-billing: Platform note: our billing system supports scheduled invoices but quarterly on this SKU requires a different billing profile. If we switch billing cadence we must provision a new billing profile and invoice template so PO fields show. That will add ~48 hours to setup. If procurement insists on PO number on each invoice, set PO on subscription metadata to avoid rework.

eileen-se: From enablement/SE: If they go quarterly, we should lock in an enablement cadence (onboarding QBR) and a seat-change window to reduce churn risk. Also want to confirm whether seat usage spikes during month-ends — that affects our telemetry & true-up discussions.

ana-cs: Customer confirmed billing entity: Maprise LLC, US-EIN 98-7654321. Procurement will provide PO number once delegated-signer language is in the addendum. I'll request PO now.

tiffany-legal: I'll draft a 3-sentence addendum: (1) delegated-signer paragraph, (2) invoice/PO acknowledgement clause, (3) early-termination credit formula placeholder to be filled by finance. Post draft here for quick redline.

ravi-finance: Propose early-termination credit = remaining unused full months * (monthly rate) * 50% (to account for procurement admin). If legal needs exact language we can convert to math and example. Also confirm whether this is a one-off concession.

sam-ops-billing: A few operational asks: set subscription PO metadata = provided PO, set billing cadence = quarterly, attach invoice template = "PO-enabled", plan to schedule change for Tue morning after approvals. Will need ticket to billing ops.

docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope pre-created 1778888900 "Maprise Billing Addendum" awaiting legal redline assignment.

eileen-se: Recommend we include a short onboarding checklist attached to the addendum so customer can't claim enablement delays later. Simple one-pager: kickoff, two QBRs, seat review checkpoints.

leo-acct: Once legal + finance approve, send DocuSign as "Sign and Return". If procurement requests a wet-signature or separate PO governance, escalate to CS manager. Try to avoid full contract amendment language.

ana-cs: Plan of action: 1) Tiffany to post addendum draft within 2 hours; 2) Ravi to confirm early-termination formula and credit-app requirement; 3) Sam to open billing ticket and prep invoice template; 4) I will request PO from customer and set Gainsight renewal to "at-risk" if DocuSign not launched in 48h.

tiffany-legal: Draft posted below and linked. Expect minimal edits.

ravi-finance: Confirmed: credit-app required; finance will generate credit-app link to send to procurement. Early-termination formula approved as proposed.

nana-cs: Thanks team. Will follow-up in-thread after PO arrives and once legal redline is done. :memo:
